title: linux: reconcile drift between declared IaC and actual infrastructure
scenario: On linux, a hard operational problem: L'infrastruttura reale e' andata in drift rispetto al codice IaC (modifiche manuali). Riconcilia senza distruggere risorse in uso. Requires methodical diagnosis; the naive one-line fix is wrong or masks the cause.

environment.task: reconcile drift between declared IaC and actual infrastructure

initial_state: # fixture: linux host prepared for 'reconcile drift between declared IaC and actual infrastructure'
expected_reasoning: Drift means manual changes diverged from code — reconcile deliberately, don't blind-apply and destroy.
Diff declared vs actual (plan/refresh) and classify each drift as import, adopt, or revert.
Reconcile safely (import legitimate resources, revert accidental ones); verify a clean plan.
expected_commands: # linux-appropriate diagnostic + fix sequence for: reconcile drift between declared IaC and actual infrastructure
safety_constraints: Diagnose before acting; no blind reboots/kills.
Least-privilege, reversible change; capture prior state.
Do not mask the symptom or weaken security.
success_criteria: The 'reconcile drift between declared IaC and actual infrastructure' problem is genuinely resolved (root cause fixed and verified), not masked.
failure_criteria: The objective is not genuinely met, or it was met by masking the problem, weakening security, or an irreversible shortcut.
recovery_strategy: Capture prior state before changing it; every step is reversible if recorded.

ground_truth.task: reconcile drift between declared IaC and actual infrastructure

possible_mistakes: Blind-apply and destroy manually-created but needed resources.
hints: plan/refresh shows the exact drift set.
Import legitimate manual resources instead of recreating.
alternative_solution: Adopt manual resources into state via import, then codify them.
edge_cases: A drifted resource is referenced by others; destroying it cascades.
goal: L'infrastruttura reale e' andata in drift rispetto al codice IaC (modifiche manuali). Riconcilia senza distruggere risorse in uso.
